license_note: The official IBM model card and its metadata name Apache 2.0 as the license for the published Granite-4.2-8B repository. The repository carries the license in its pinned model card rather than a separate license file, as with other Granite releases.

license_evidence.scope: Official granite-4.2-8b model repository, Safetensors checkpoint, tokenizer, and chat template

access_boundary: This record represents the ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b instruct reasoning release dated August 25, 2026 at Hugging Face commit f8de16cdcdbc6c779ca517604e050d82cc119e44. The Granite-4.1-8B-Base model it derives from, the 3B and 30B Granite 4.2 siblings, the Granite 4.0 generation, quantizations, IBM-hosted services, and independent hosts are separate boundaries.
strengths: IBM publishes ungated Safetensors shards with a model.sig signature file under an OSI-approved license
The model card documents vLLM and SGLang serving, a custom thinking parser, and a dated release
tradeoffs: The license statement is carried in model-card metadata and a badge rather than a repository license file
The model card documents no IBM-hosted serving path, so managed availability must be verified separately
